name: La Torre Onírica
source:
You're an aspiring writer, but before you begin a long and tedious play, you decide to search for a job writing stories for a important entertainment magazine. You speak to the boss and promises to give you a position, but under one condition: it's only a few days before halloween so he asks you for a horror tale that can impress him, unfortunately, you're unluckily out of ideas of what to write about. You end up sharing your doubts with a friend who suggest you to visit a relative of his, as he remembers how he used to constantly tell him about a strange tower he used to see in his dreams. You have nothing to lose anyways, and you really want that job more than anything else, so you decide to visit Mr. Chris Cooper.

[From [url=https://roger-g-thunder.itch.io/the-oniric-tower]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一位懷抱理想的作家。在開始漫長而枯燥的創作之前，你決定先找一份工作，為一家重要的娛樂雜誌撰寫故事。你向主編求職，對方答應給你職位，但有一個條件：離萬聖節只剩幾天，他要你寫一個能打動他的恐怖故事。偏偏你毫無靈感。

你向朋友傾訴煩惱，朋友建議你去拜訪一位親戚，因為他記得對方曾不斷講起夢中出現的一座奇怪高塔。反正也沒什麼損失，而且你很想得到那份工作，於是決定去拜訪Chris Cooper先生。

[來源：[url=https://roger-g-thunder.itch.io/the-oniric-tower]Itch.io[/url]]
